name: usage-hud
description: Shows 5-hour and 7-day usage left with reset times, and whether the prompt cache is hot or cold

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto uses 1h until Claude Code reports a different TTL; 5m or 1h forces it

theme.title: Look
theme.description: terminal is the default look (monospace phosphor strip) drawn in the desktop app, mobile and VS Code; clean is a minimal card; classic is the older neutral card; midnight, paper, sunset and mono are alternative looks; text draws text everywhere. The terminal app always draws text.
